agendas.name: Angels of Death
agendas.description: At battle end, if no enemy units remain on the battlefield, each ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit still on the battlefield gains 2XP. The force also gains 2 Honour points.

agendas.name: Know No Fear
agendas.description: Post-game: each ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that never failed a Battle-shock test gains 1XP (2XP if the unit was Below Half-strength at any point). Track Battle-shock pass/fail per unit during the game.

agendas.name: Armoured Assault
agendas.description: Post-game: each surviving ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE gains 1XP. Each destroyed VEHICLE that destroyed 2+ enemy units during the battle also gains 1XP.

agendas.name: Quest of Atonement
agendas.description: Pre-game: select 1 ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit with a Battle-weary, Disgraced, or Mark of Shame scar. If that unit destroyed an enemy Character, Monster, or Vehicle in melee, it loses 1 scar and gains 5XP.

agendas.name: Interrogate the Mysterious Figure
agendas.description: If the enemy WARLORD is destroyed by an attack made by a DEATHWING, RAVENWING, or INNER CIRCLE unit, that unit gains 3XP and the force gains 2 Honour points.

agendas.name: Encircle the Foe
agendas.description: At battle end, select 3 or 4 RAVENWING units (excluding AIRCRAFT). Each must be wholly within 9" of a different corner of the battlefield. Each selected unit gains 2XP.

agendas.name: The Deathwing Cometh
agendas.description: At the end of your turn, if a DEATHWING unit that arrived via Deep Strike this turn destroyed one or more enemy units, it gains 2XP. If any destroyed enemy unit was a CHARACTER, it gains 3XP instead.

agendas.name: Mental Interrogation
agendas.description: At the start of your Shooting phase, select one DARK ANGELS PSYKER unit that is not Battle-shocked and is eligible to shoot. If within 12" of one or more enemy CHARACTER units, it gains 1XP.
